v.t: Alif, Lam, Ra. A Scripture whose Verses were perfected, then elaborated, from One who is Wise and Informed
v.l: Alif-Lam-Ra Kitabun 'Uhkimat 'Ayatuhu Thumma Fussilat Min Ladun Hakimin Khabirin

v.t: That you shall worship none but God. “I am a warner to you from Him, and a bearer of good news.”
v.l: Alla Ta`budu 'Illa Allaha 'Innani Lakum Minhu Nadhirun Wa Bashirun
w: and a bearer of glad tidings

v.t: “And ask your Lord for forgiveness, and repent to Him. He will provide you with good sustenance until a stated term, and will bestow His grace on every possessor of virtue. But if you turn away, then I fear for you the punishment of a grievous Day.”
v.l: Wa 'Ani Astaghfiru Rabbakum Thumma Tubu 'Ilayhi Yumatti`kum Mata`aan Hasanaan 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan Wa Yu'uti Kulla Dhi Fađlin Fađlahu Wa 'In Tawallaw Fa'inni 'Akhafu `Alaykum `Adhaba Yawmin Kabirin

v.t: “To God is your return, and He is Capable of all things.”
v.l: Ila Allahi Marji`ukum Wa Huwa `Ala Kulli Shay'in Qadirun

v.t: They wrap their chests to hide from Him. But even as they cover themselves with their clothes, He knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He knows what lies within the hearts
v.l: Ala 'Innahum Yathnuna Sudurahum Liyastakhfu Minhu 'Ala Hina Yastaghshuna Thiyabahum Ya`lamu Ma Yusirruna Wa Ma Yu`linuna 'Innahu `Alimun Bidhati As-Suduri

v.t: There is no moving creature on earth but its sustenance depends on God. And He knows where it lives and where it rests. Everything is in a Clear Book
v.l: Wa Ma Min Dabbatin Fi Al-'Arđi 'Illa `Ala Allahi Rizquha Wa Ya`lamu Mustaqarraha Wa Mustawda`aha Kullun Fi Kitabin Mubinin

v.t: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days—and His Throne was upon the waters—in order to test you—which of you is best in conduct. And if you were to say, “You will be resurrected after death,” those who disbelieve would say, “This is nothing but plain witchcraft.”
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Fi Sittati 'Ayyamin Wa Kana `Arshuhu `Ala Al-Ma'i Liyabluwakum 'Ayyukum 'Ahsanu `Amalaan Wa La'in Qulta 'Innakum Mab`uthuna Min Ba`di Al-Mawti Layaqulanna Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'In Hadha 'Illa Sihrun Mubinun

v.t: And if We postponed their punishment until a stated time, they would say, “What holds it back?” On the Day when it reaches them, it will not be averted from them, and what they used to ridicule will besiege them
v.l: Wa La'in 'Akhkharna `Anhumu Al-`Adhaba 'Ila 'Ummatin Ma`dudatin Layaqulunna Ma Yahbisuhu 'Ala Yawma Ya'tihim Laysa Masrufaan `Anhum Wa Haqa Bihim Ma Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'un

v.t: If We give the human being a taste of mercy from Us, and then withdraw it from him, he becomes despairing and ungrateful
v.l: Wa La'in 'Adhaqna Al-'Insana Minna Rahmatan Thumma Naza`naha Minhu 'Innahu Laya'usun Kafurun

v.t: And if We give him a taste of prosperity, after some adversity has afflicted him, he will say, “Troubles have gone away from me.” He becomes excited and proud
v.l: Wa La'in 'Adhaqnahu Na`ma'a Ba`da Đarra'a Massat/hu Layaqulanna Dhahaba As-Sayyi'atu `Anni 'Innahu Lafarihun Fakhurun

v.t: Except those who are patient and do good deeds—these will have forgiveness and a great reward
v.l: Illa Al-Ladhina Sabaru Wa `Amilu As-Salihati 'Ula'ika Lahum Maghfiratun Wa 'Ajrun Kabirun

v.t: Perhaps you wish to disregard some of what is revealed to you, and you may be stressed because of it, since they say, “If only a treasure was sent down to him, or an angel came with him.” You are only a warner, and God is Responsible for all things
v.l: Fala`allaka Tarikun Ba`đa Ma Yuha 'Ilayka Wa Đa'iqun Bihi Sadruka 'An Yaqulu Lawla 'Unzila `Alayhi Kanzun 'Aw Ja'a Ma`ahu Malakun 'Innama 'Anta Nadhirun Wa Allahu `Ala Kulli Shay'in Wa Kilun

v.t: Or do they say, “He invented it?” Say, “Then produce ten chapters like it, invented, and call upon whomever you can, besides God, if you are truthful.”
v.l: Am Yaquluna Aftarahu Qul Fa'tu Bi`ashri Suwarin Mithlihi Muftarayatin Wa Ad`u Mani Astata`tum Min Duni Allahi 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: But if they fail to answer you, know that it was revealed with God’s knowledge, and that there is no god but He. Will you then submit
v.l: Fa'illam Yastajibu Lakum Fa`lamu 'Annama 'Unzila Bi`ilmi Allahi Wa 'An La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Fahal 'Antum Muslimuna

v.t: Whoever desires the worldly life and its glitter—We will fully recompense them for their deeds therein, and therein they will not be defrauded
v.l: Man Kana Yuridu Al-Hayaata Ad-Dunya Wa Zinataha Nuwaffi 'Ilayhim 'A`malahum Fiha Wa Hum Fiha La Yubkhasuna

v.t: These—they will have nothing but the Fire in the Hereafter. Their deeds are in vain therein, and their works are null
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina Laysa Lahum Fi Al-'Akhirati 'Illa An-Naru Wa Habita Ma Sana`u Fiha Wa Batilun Ma Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: Is he who possesses a clear proof from his Lord, recited by a witness from Him, and before it the Book of Moses, a guide and a mercy? These believe in it. But whoever defies it from among the various factions, the Fire is his promise. So have no doubt about it. It is the truth from your Lord, but most people do not believe
v.l: Afaman Kana `Ala Bayyinatin Min Rabbihi Wa Yatluhu Shahidun Minhu Wa Min Qablihi Kitabu Musa 'Imamaan Wa Rahmatan 'Ula'ika Yu'uminuna Bihi Wa Man Yakfur Bihi Mina Al-'Ahzabi Falnnaru Maw`iduhu Fala Takun Fi Miryatin Minhu 'Innahu Al-Haqqu Min Rabbika Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Yu'uminuna

v.t: Who does greater wrong than he who fabricates lies about God? These will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, “These are they who lied about their Lord.” Indeed, the curse of God is upon the wrongdoers
v.l: Wa Man 'Azlamu Mimmani Aftara `Ala Allahi Kadhibaan 'Ula'ika Yu`rađuna `Ala Rabbihim Wa Yaqulu Al-'Ash/hadu Ha'uula' Al-Ladhina Kadhabu `Ala Rabbihim 'Ala La`natu Allahi `Ala Az-Zalimina

v.t: Those who hinder others from the path of God, and seek to make it crooked; and regarding the Hereafter, they are in denial
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yasudduna `An Sabili Allahi Wa Yabghunaha `Iwajaan Wa Hum Bil-'Akhirati Hum Kafiruna

v.t: These will not escape on earth, and they have no protectors besides God. The punishment will be doubled for them. They have failed to hear, and they have failed to see
v.l: Ula'ika Lam Yakunu Mu`jizina Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Kana Lahum Min Duni Allahi Min 'Awliya'a Yuđa`afu Lahumu Al-`Adhabu Ma Kanu Yastati`una As-Sam`a Wa Ma Kanu Yubsiruna

v.t: Those are the ones who lost their souls, and what they had invented has strayed away from them
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina Khasiru 'Anfusahum Wa Đalla `Anhum Ma Kanu Yaftaruna

v.t: Without a doubt, in the Hereafter, they will be the biggest losers
v.l: La Jarama 'Annahum Fi Al-'Akhirati Humu Al-'Akhsaruna

v.t: As for those who believe and do good deeds, and humble themselves before their Lord—these are the inhabitants of Paradise, where they will abide forever
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Wa 'Akhbatu 'Ila Rabbihim 'Ula'ika 'Ashabu Al-Jannati Hum Fiha Khaliduna

v.t: The parable of the two groups is that of the blind and the deaf, and the seeing and the hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Will you not reflect
v.l: Mathalu Al-Fariqayni Kal'a`ma Wa Al-'Asammi Wa Al-Basiri Wa As-Sami`i Hal Yastawiyani Mathalaan 'Afala Tadhakkaruna

v.t: We sent Noah to his people, “I am to you a clear warner.”
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Nuhaan 'Ila Qawmihi 'Inni Lakum Nadhirun Mubinun

v.t: “That you shall worship none but God. I fear for you the agony of a painful Day.”
v.l: An La Ta`budu 'Illa Allaha 'Inni 'Akhafu `Alaykum `Adhaba Yawmin 'Alimin

v.t: The notables who disbelieved among his people said, “We see in you nothing but a man like us, and we see that only the worst among us have followed you, those of immature judgment. And we see that you have no advantage over us. In fact, we think you are liars.”
v.l: Faqala Al-Mala'u Al-Ladhina Kafaru Min Qawmihi Ma Naraka 'Illa Basharaan Mithlana Wa Ma Naraka Attaba`aka 'Illa Al-Ladhina Hum 'Aradhiluna Badiya Ar-Ra'yi Wa Ma Nara Lakum `Alayna Min Fađlin Bal Nazunnukum Kadhibina

v.t: He said, “O my people, Have you considered? If I stand on clear evidence from my Lord, and He has given me a mercy from Himself, but you were blind to it, can we compel you to accept it, even though you dislike it?”
v.l: Qala Ya Qawmi 'Ara'aytum 'In Kuntu `Ala Bayyinatin Min Rabbi Wa 'Atani Rahmatan Min `Indihi Fa`ummiyat `Alaykum 'Anulzimukumuha Wa 'Antum Laha Karihuna
w: should We compel you (to accept) it

v.t: “O my people! I ask of you no money for it. My reward lies only with God. And I am not about to dismiss those who believed; they will surely meet their Lord. And I see that you are ignorant people.”
v.l: Wa Yaqawmi La 'As'alukum `Alayhi Malaan 'In 'Ajriya 'Illa `Ala Allahi Wa Ma 'Ana Bitaridi Al-Ladhina 'Amanu 'Innahum Mulaqu Rabbihim Wa Lakinni 'Arakum Qawmaan Tajhaluna

v.t: “O my people! Who will support me against God, if I dismiss them? Will you not give a thought?”
v.l: Wa Yaqawmi Man Yansuruni Mina Allahi 'In Taradtuhum 'Afala Tadhakkaruna

v.t: “I do not say to you that I possess the treasures of God, nor do I know the future, nor do I say that I am an angel. Nor do I say of those who are despicable in your eyes that God will never give them any good. God is Aware of what lies in their souls. If I did, I would be one of the wrongdoers.”
v.l: Wa La 'Aqulu Lakum `Indi Khaza'inu Allahi Wa La 'A`lamu Al-Ghayba Wa La 'Aqulu 'Inni Malakun Wa La 'Aqulu Lilladhina Tazdari 'A`yunukum Lan Yu'utiyahumu Allahu Khayraan Allahu 'A`lamu Bima Fi 'Anfusihim 'Inni 'Idhaan Lamina Az-Zalimina

v.t: They said, “O Noah, you have argued with us, and argued a great deal. Now bring upon us what you threaten us with, if you are truthful.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Nuhu Qad Jadaltana Fa'aktharta Jidalana Fa'tina Bima Ta`iduna 'In Kunta Mina As-Sadiqina

v.t: He said, “It is God who will bring it upon you, if He wills, and you will not be able to escape.”
v.l: Qala 'Innama Ya'tikum Bihi Allahu 'In Sha'a Wa Ma 'Antum Bimu`jizina

v.t: “My advice will not benefit you, much as I may want to advise you, if God desires to confound you. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned.”
v.l: Wa La Yanfa`ukum Nushi 'In 'Aradtu 'An 'Ansaha Lakum 'In Kana Allahu Yuridu 'An Yughwiyakum Huwa Rabbukum Wa 'Ilayhi Turja`una

v.t: Or do they say, “He made it up?” Say, “If I made it up, upon me falls my crime, and I am innocent of the crimes you commit.”
v.l: Am Yaquluna Aftarahu Qul 'Ini Aftaraytuhu Fa`alayya 'Ijrami Wa 'Ana Bari'un Mimma Tujrimuna

v.t: And it was revealed to Noah: “None of your people will believe, except those who have already believed, so do not grieve over what they do.”
v.l: Wa 'Uhiya 'Ila Nuhin 'Annahu Lan Yu'umina Min Qawmika 'Illa Man Qad 'Amana Fala Tabta'is Bima Kanu Yaf`aluna

v.t: “And build the Ark, under Our eyes, and with Our inspiration, and do not address Me regarding those who did wrong; they are to be drowned.”
v.l: Wa Asna`i Al-Fulka Bi'a`yunina Wa Wahyina Wa La Tukhatibni Fi Al-Ladhina Zalamu 'Innahum Mughraquna

v.t: As he was building the ark, whenever some of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, “If you ridicule us, we will ridicule you, just as you ridicule.”
v.l: Wa Yasna`u Al-Fulka Wa Kullama Marra `Alayhi Mala'un Min Qawmihi Sakhiru Minhu Qala 'In Taskharu Minna Fa'inna Naskharu Minkum Kama Taskharuna

v.t: “You will surely know upon whom will come a torment that will abase him, and upon whom will fall a lasting torment.”
v.l: Fasawfa Ta`lamuna Man Ya'tihi `Adhabun Yukhzihi Wa Yahillu `Alayhi `Adhabun Muqimun

v.t: Until, when Our command came, and the volcano erupted, We said, “Board into it a pair of every kind, and your family—except those against whom the sentence has already been passed—and those who have believed.” But those who believed with him were only a few
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Ja'a 'Amruna Wa Fara At-Tannuru Qulna Ahmil Fiha Min Kullin Zawjayni Athnayni Wa 'Ahlaka 'Illa Man Sabaqa `Alayhi Al-Qawlu Wa Man 'Amana Wa Ma 'Amana Ma`ahu 'Illa Qalilun

v.t: He said, “Embark in it. In the name of God shall be its sailing and its anchorage. My Lord is indeed Forgiving and Merciful.”
v.l: Wa Qala Arkabu Fiha Bismi Allahi Majraha Wa Mursaha 'Inna Rabbi Laghafurun Rahimun

v.t: And so it sailed with them amidst waves like hills. And Noah called to his son, who had kept away, “On my son! Embark with us, and do not be with the disbelievers.”
v.l: Wa Hiya Tajri Bihim Fi Mawjin Kaljibali Wa Nada Nuhun Abnahu Wa Kana Fi Ma`zilin Ya Bunayya Arkab Ma`ana Wa La Takun Ma`a Al-Kafirina

v.t: He said, “I will take refuge on a mountain—it will protect me from the water.” He said, “There is no protection from God’s decree today, except for him on whom He has mercy.” And the waves surged between them, and he was among the drowned
v.l: Qala Sa'awi 'Ila Jabalin Ya`simuni Mina Al-Ma'i Qala La `Asima Al-Yawma Min 'Amri Allahi 'Illa Man Rahima Wa Hala Baynahuma Al-Mawju Fakana Mina Al-Mughraqina

v.t: And it was said, “O earth, swallow your waters,” and “O heaven, clear up.” And the waters receded, and the event was concluded, and it settled on Judi, and it was proclaimed: “Away with the wicked people.”
v.l: Wa Qila Ya 'Arđu Abla`i Ma'aki Wa Ya Sama'u 'Aqli`i Wa Ghiđa Al-Ma'u Wa Quđiya Al-'Amru Wa Astawat `Ala Al-Judiyi Wa Qila Bu`daan Lilqawmi Az-Zalimina

v.t: And Noah called to his Lord. He said, “O My Lord, my son is of my family, and Your promise is true, and You are the Wisest of the wise.”
v.l: Wa Nada Nuhun Rabbahu Faqala Rabbi 'Inna Abni Min 'Ahli Wa 'Inna Wa`daka Al-Haqqu Wa 'Anta 'Ahkamu Al-Hakimina

v.t: He said, “O Noah, he is not of your family. It is an unrighteous deed. So do not ask Me about something you know nothing about. I admonish you, lest you be one of the ignorant.”
v.l: Qala Ya Nuhu 'Innahu Laysa Min 'Ahlika 'Innahu `Amalun Ghayru Salihin Fala Tas'alni Ma Laysa Laka Bihi `Ilmun 'Inni 'A`izuka 'An Takuna Mina Al-Jahilina

v.t: He said, “O My Lord, I seek refuge with You, from asking You about what I have no knowledge of. Unless You forgive me, and have mercy on me, I will be one of the losers.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi 'Inni 'A`udhu Bika 'An 'As'alaka Ma Laysa Li Bihi `Ilmun Wa 'Illa Taghfir Li Wa Tarhamni 'Akun Mina Al-Khasirina
w: and You have mercy on me

v.t: It was said, “O Noah, disembark with peace from Us; and with blessings upon you, and upon communities from those with you. And other communities We will grant prosperity, and then a painful torment from Us will befall them.”
v.l: Qila Ya Nuhu Ahbit Bisalamin Minna Wa Barakatin `Alayka Wa `Ala 'Umamin Mimman Ma`aka Wa 'Umamun Sanumatti`uhum Thumma Yamassuhum Minna `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: These are some stories from the past that we reveal to you. Neither you, nor your people knew them before this. So be patient. The future belongs to the pious
v.l: Tilka Min 'Anba'i Al-Ghaybi Nuhiha 'Ilayka Ma Kunta Ta`lamuha 'Anta Wa La Qawmuka Min Qabli Hadha Fasbir 'Inna Al-`Aqibata Lilmuttaqina

v.t: And to Aad, their brother Hud. He said, “O my people, worship God, you have no other god besides Him. You do nothing but invent lies.”
v.l: Wa 'Ila `Adin 'Akhahum Hudaan Qala Ya Qawmi A`budu Allaha Ma Lakum Min 'Ilahin Ghayruhu 'In 'Antum 'Illa Muftaruna

v.t: “O my people, I ask you no wage for it; my wage lies with Him who originated me. Do you not understand?”
v.l: Ya Qawmi La 'As'alukum `Alayhi 'Ajraan 'In 'Ajriya 'Illa `Ala Al-Ladhi Fatarani 'Afala Ta`qiluna

v.t: “O my people, ask forgiveness from your Lord, and repent to Him. He will release the sky pouring down upon you, and will add strength to your strength. And do not turn away and be wicked.”
v.l: Wa Ya Qawmi Astaghfiru Rabbakum Thumma Tubu 'Ilayhi Yursili As-Sama'a `Alaykum Midraraan Wa Yazidkum Quwatan 'Ila Quwatikum Wa La Tatawallaw Mujrimina

v.t: They said, “O Hud, you did not bring us any evidence, and we are not about to abandon our gods at your word, and we are not believers in you.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Hudu Ma Ji'tana Bibayyinatin Wa Ma Nahnu Bitariki 'Alihatina `An Qawlika Wa Ma Nahnu Laka Bimu'uminina

v.t: “We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil.” He said, “I call God to witness, and you to witness, that I am innocent of what you associate
v.l: In Naqulu 'Illa A`taraka Ba`đu 'Alihatina Bisu'in Qala 'Inni 'Ush/hidu Allaha Wa Ash/hadu 'Anni Bari'un Mimma Tushrikuna

v.t: Besides Him. So scheme against me, all of you, and do not hesitate
v.l: Min Dunihi Fakiduni Jami`aan Thumma La Tunziruni

v.t: I have placed my trust in God, my Lord and your Lord. There is not a creature but He holds it by the forelock. My Lord is on a straight path
v.l: Inni Tawakkaltu `Ala Allahi Rabbi Wa Rabbikum Ma Min Dabbatin 'Illa Huwa 'Akhidhun Binasiyatiha 'Inna Rabbi `Ala Siratin Mustaqimin

v.t: If you turn away, I have conveyed to you what I was sent to you with; and my Lord will replace you with another people, and you will not cause Him any harm. My Lord is Guardian over all things.”
v.l: Fa'in Tawallaw Faqad 'Ablaghtukum Ma 'Ursiltu Bihi 'Ilaykum Wa Yastakhlifu Rabbi Qawmaan Ghayrakum Wa La Tađurrunahu Shay'aan 'Inna Rabbi `Ala Kulli Shay'in Hafizun
w: And my Lord will give succession
And my Lord will give succession

v.t: And when Our decree came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by a mercy from Us, and We delivered them from a harsh punishment
v.l: Wa Lamma Ja'a 'Amruna Najjayna Hudaan Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Ma`ahu Birahmatin Minna Wa Najjaynahum Min `Adhabin Ghalizin

v.t: That was Aad; they denied the signs of their Lord, and defied His messengers, and followed the lead of every stubborn tyrant
v.l: Wa Tilka `Adun Jahadu Bi'ayati Rabbihim Wa `Asaw Rusulahu Wa Attaba`u 'Amra Kulli Jabbarin `Anidin

v.t: And they were pursued by a curse in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, Aad blasphemed against their Lord—so away with Aad, the people of Hud
v.l: Wa 'Utbi`u Fi Hadhihi Ad-Dunya La`natan Wa Yawma Al-Qiyamati 'Ala 'Inna `Adaan Kafaru Rabbahum 'Ala Bu`daan Li`adin Qawmi Hudin

v.t: And to Thamood, their brother Saleh. He said, “O my people, worship God, you have no god other than Him. He initiated you from the earth, and settled you in it. So seek His forgiveness, and repent to Him. My Lord is Near and Responsive.”
v.l: Wa 'Ila Thamuda 'Akhahum Salihaan Qala Ya Qawmi A`budu Allaha Ma Lakum Min 'Ilahin Ghayruhu Huwa 'Ansha'akum Mina Al-'Arđi Wa Asta`marakum Fiha Fastaghfiruhu Thumma Tubu 'Ilayhi 'Inna Rabbi Qaribun Mujibun

v.t: They said, “O Saleh, we had hopes in you before this. Are you trying to prevent us from worshiping what our parents worship? We are in serious doubt regarding what you are calling us to.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Salihu Qad Kunta Fina Marjuwaan Qabla Hadha 'Atanhana 'An Na`buda Ma Ya`budu 'Aba'uuna Wa 'Innana Lafi Shakkin Mimma Tad`una 'Ilayhi Muribin
w: the one in whom hope was placed

v.t: He said, “O my people, have you considered? If I stand upon clear evidence from my Lord, and He has given me mercy from Him, who would protect me from God, if I disobeyed Him? You add nothing for me except loss.”
v.l: Qala Ya Qawmi 'Ara'aytum 'In Kuntu `Ala Bayyinatin Min Rabbi Wa 'Atani Minhu Rahmatan Faman Yansuruni Mina Allahi 'In `Asaytuhu Fama Tazidunani Ghayra Takhsirin

v.t: “O my people, this is the she-camel of God, a sign for you. Let her graze on God’s land, and do not harm her, lest an imminent punishment overtakes you.”
v.l: Wa Ya Qawmi Hadhihi Naqatu Allahi Lakum 'Ayatan Fadharuha Ta'kul Fi 'Arđi Allahi Wa La Tamassuha Bisu'in Faya'khudhakum `Adhabun Qaribun

v.t: But they hamstrung her, and so He said, “Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. This is a prophecy that is infallible.”
v.l: Fa`aqaruha Faqala Tamatta`u Fi Darikum Thalathata 'Ayyamin Dhalika Wa`dun Ghayru Makdhubin

v.t: Then, when Our command came, We saved Saleh and those who believed with him, by a mercy from Us, from the disgrace of that day. Your Lord is the Strong, the Mighty
v.l: Falamma Ja'a 'Amruna Najjayna Salihaan Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Ma`ahu Birahmatin Minna Wa Min Khizyi Yawmi'idhin 'Inna Rabbaka Huwa Al-Qawiyu Al-`Azizu

v.t: And the Scream struck those who transgressed, and they became motionless bodies in their homes
v.l: Wa 'Akhadha Al-Ladhina Zalamu As-Sayhatu Fa'asbahu Fi Diyarihim Jathimina

v.t: As if they had never prospered therein. Indeed, Thamood rejected their Lord, so away with Thamood
v.l: Ka'an Lam Yaghnaw Fiha 'Ala 'Inna Thamuda Kafaru Rabbahum 'Ala Bu`daan Lithamuda

v.t: Our messengers came to Abraham with good news. They said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace.” Soon after, he came with a roasted calf
v.l: Wa Laqad Ja'at Rusuluna 'Ibrahima Bil-Bushra Qalu Salamaan Qala Salamun Fama Labitha 'An Ja'a Bi`ijlin Hanidhin

v.t: But when he saw their hands not reaching towards it, he became suspicious of them, and conceived a fear of them. They said, “Do not fear, we were sent to the people of Lot.”
v.l: Falamma Ra'a 'Aydiyahum La Tasilu 'Ilayhi Nakirahum Wa 'Awjasa Minhum Khifatan Qalu La Takhaf 'Inna 'Ursilna 'Ila Qawmi Lutin

v.t: His wife was standing by, so she laughed. And We gave her good news of Isaac; and after Isaac, Jacob
v.l: Wa Amra'atuhu Qa'imatun Fađahikat Fabasharnaha Bi'ishaqa Wa Min Wara'i 'Ishaqa Ya`quba
w: Then We gave her glad tidings

v.t: She said, “Alas for me. Shall I give birth, when I am an old woman, and this, my husband, is an old man? This is truly a strange thing.”
v.l: Qalat Ya Waylata 'A'alidu Wa 'Ana `Ajuzun Wa Hadha Ba`li Shaykhaan 'Inna Hadha Lashay'un `Ajibun

v.t: They said, “Do you marvel at the decree of God? The mercy and blessings of God are upon you, O people of the house. He is Praiseworthy and Glorious.”
v.l: Qalu 'Ata`jabina Min 'Amri Allahi Rahmatu Allahi Wa Barakatuhu `Alaykum 'Ahla Al-Bayti 'Innahu Hamidun Majidun

v.t: When Abraham's fear subsided, and the good news had reached him, he started pleading with Us concerning the people of Lot
v.l: Falamma Dhahaba `An 'Ibrahima Ar-Raw`u Wa Ja'at/hu Al-Bushra Yujadiluna Fi Qawmi Lutin

v.t: Abraham was gentle, kind, penitent
v.l: Inna 'Ibrahima Lahalimun 'Awwahun Munibun

v.t: “O Abraham, refrain from this. The command of your Lord has come; they have incurred an irreversible punishment.”
v.l: Ya 'Ibrahimu 'A`riđ `An Hadha 'Innahu Qad Ja'a 'Amru Rabbika Wa 'Innahum 'Atihim `Adhabun Ghayru Mardudin

v.t: And when Our envoys came to Lot, he was anxious for them, and concerned for them. He said, “This is a dreadful day.”
v.l: Wa Lamma Ja'at Rusuluna Lutaan Si'a Bihim Wa Đaqa Bihim Dhar`aan Wa Qala Hadha Yawmun `Asibun

v.t: And his people came rushing towards him—they were in the habit of committing sins. He said, “O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear God, and do not embarrass me before my guests. Is there not one reasonable man among you?”
v.l: Wa Ja'ahu Qawmuhu Yuhra`una 'Ilayhi Wa Min Qablu Kanu Ya`maluna As-Sayyi'ati Qala Ya Qawmi Ha'uula' Banati Hunna 'Atharu Lakum Fa Attaqu Allaha Wa La Tukhzuni Fi Đayfi 'Alaysa Minkum Rajulun Rashidun

v.t: They said, “You know well that we have no right to your daughters, and you know well what we want.”
v.l: Qalu Laqad `Alimta Ma Lana Fi Banatika Min Haqqin Wa 'Innaka Lata`lamu Ma Nuridu

v.t: He said, “If only I had the strength to stop you, or could rely on some strong support.”
v.l: Qala Law 'Anna Li Bikum Quwatan 'Aw 'Awi 'Ila Ruknin Shadidin

v.t: They said, “O Lot, we are the envoys of your Lord; they will not reach you. So set out with your family during the cover of the night, and let none of you look back, except for your wife. She will be struck by what will strike them. Their appointed time is the morning. Is not the morning near?”
v.l: Qalu Ya Lutu 'Inna Rusulu Rabbika Lan Yasilu 'Ilayka Fa'asri Bi'ahlika Biqit`in Mina Al-Layli Wa La Yaltafit Minkum 'Ahadun 'Illa Amra'ataka 'Innahu Musibuha Ma 'Asabahum 'Inna Maw`idahumu As-Subhu 'Alaysa As-Subhu Biqaribin

v.t: And when Our command came about, We turned it upside down, and We rained down on it stones of baked clay
v.l: Falamma Ja'a 'Amruna Ja`alna `Aliyaha Safilaha Wa 'Amtarna `Alayha Hijaratan Min Sijjilin Manđudin

v.t: Marked from your Lord, and never far from the wrongdoers
v.l: Musawwamatan `Inda Rabbika Wa Ma Hiya Mina Az-Zalimina Biba`idin

v.t: And to Median, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship God; you have no god other than Him. And do not short measure or short weight. I see you in good circumstances, but I fear for you the agony of an encompassing Day.”
v.l: Wa 'Ila Madyana 'Akhahum Shu`aybaan Qala Ya Qawmi A`budu Allaha Ma Lakum Min 'Ilahin Ghayruhu Wa La Tanqusu Al-Mikya La Wa Al-Mizana 'Inni 'Arakum Bikhayrin Wa 'Inni 'Akhafu `Alaykum `Adhaba Yawmin Muhitin

v.t: “O my people! Give full measure and full weight, in all fairness, and do not cheat the people out of their rights, and do not spread corruption in the land
v.l: Wa Ya Qawmi 'Awfu Al-Mikyala Wa Al-Mizana Bil-Qisti Wa La Tabkhasu An-Nasa 'Ashya'ahum Wa La Ta`thaw Fi Al-'Arđi Mufsidina

v.t: What is left by God is best for you, if you are believers. And I am not a guardian over you.”
v.l: Baqiyatu Allahi Khayrun Lakum 'In Kuntum Mu'uminina Wa Ma 'Ana `Alaykum Bihafizin

v.t: They said, “O Shuaib, does your prayer command you that we abandon what our ancestors worshiped, or doing with our wealth what we want? You are the one who is intelligent and wise.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Shu`aybu 'Asalatuka Ta'muruka 'An Natruka Ma Ya`budu 'Aba'uuna 'Aw 'An Naf`ala Fi 'Amwalina Ma Nasha'u 'Innaka La'anta Al-Halimu Ar-Rashidu

v.t: He said, “O my people, have you considered? What if I have clear evidence from my Lord, and He has given me good livelihood from Himself? I have no desire to do what I forbid you from doing. I desire nothing but reform, as far as I can. My success lies only with God. In Him I trust, and to Him I turn.”
v.l: Qala Ya Qawmi 'Ara'aytum 'In Kuntu `Ala Bayyinatin Min Rabbi Wa Razaqani Minhu Rizqaan Hasanaan Wa Ma 'Uridu 'An 'Ukhalifakum 'Ila Ma 'Anhakum `Anhu 'In 'Uridu 'Illa Al-'Islaha Ma Astata`tu Wa Ma Tawfiqi 'Illa Billahi `Alayhi Tawakkaltu Wa 'Ilayhi 'Unibu
w: as much as I am able
as much as I am able

v.t: “O my people, let not your hostility towards me cause you to suffer what was suffered by the people of Noah, or the people of Hud, or the people of Saleh. The people of Lot are not far away from you.”
v.l: Wa Ya Qawmi La Yajrimannakum Shiqaqi 'An Yusibakum Mithlu Ma 'Asaba Qawma Nuhin 'Aw Qawma Hudin 'Aw Qawma Salihin Wa Ma Qawmu Lutin Minkum Biba`idin

v.t: “And ask your Lord for forgiveness, and repent to Him. My Lord is Merciful and Loving.”
v.l: Wa Astaghfiru Rabbakum Thumma Tubu 'Ilayhi 'Inna Rabbi Rahimun Wadudun

v.t: They said, “O Shuaib, we do not understand much of what you say, and we see that you are weak among us. Were it not for your tribe, we would have stoned you. You are of no value to us.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Shu`aybu Ma Nafqahu Kathiraan Mimma Taqulu Wa 'Inna Lanaraka Fina Đa`ifaan Wa Lawla Rahtuka Larajamnaka Wa Ma 'Anta `Alayna Bi`azizin
w: surely we would have stoned you

v.t: He said, “O my people, is my tribe more important to you than God? And you have turned your backs on Him? My Lord comprehends everything you do.”
v.l: Qala Ya Qawmi 'Arahti 'A`azzu `Alaykum Mina Allahi Wa Attakhadhtumuhu Wara'akum Zihriyaan 'Inna Rabbi Bima Ta`maluna Muhitun

v.t: “O my people, do as you may, and so will I. You will know to whom will come a punishment that will shame him, and who is a liar. So look out; I am on the lookout with you.”
v.l: Wa Ya Qawmi A`malu `Ala Makanatikum 'Inni `Amilun Sawfa Ta`lamuna Man Ya'tihi `Adhabun Yukhzihi Wa Man Huwa Kadhibun Wa Artaqibu 'Inni Ma`akum Raqibun

v.t: And when Our command came, We saved Shuaib and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and the Blast struck the wrongdoers, and they became motionless bodies in their homes
v.l: Wa Lamma Ja'a 'Amruna Najjayna Shu`aybaan Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Ma`ahu Birahmatin Minna Wa 'Akhadhati Al-Ladhina Zalamu As-Sayhatu Fa'asbahu Fi Diyarihim Jathimina

v.t: As though they never flourished therein. Away with Median, as was done away with Thamood
v.l: Ka'an Lam Yaghnaw Fiha 'Ala Bu`daan Limadyana Kama Ba`idat Thamudu

v.t: And We sent Moses with Our signs and a clear mandate
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Musa Bi'ayatina Wa Sultanin Mubinin

v.t: To Pharaoh and his nobles, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not wise
v.l: Ila Fir`awna Wa Mala'ihi Fa Attaba`u 'Amra Fir`awna Wa Ma 'Amru Fir`awna Birashidin

v.t: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection, and will lead them into the Fire. Miserable is the place he placed them in
v.l: Yaqdumu Qawmahu Yawma Al-Qiyamati Fa'awradahumu An-Nara Wa Bi'sa Al-Wirdu Al-Mawrudu

v.t: They were followed by a curse in this, and on the Day of Resurrection. Miserable is the path they followed
v.l: Wa 'Utbi`u Fi Hadhihi La`natan Wa Yawma Al-Qiyamati Bi'sa Ar-Rifdu Al-Marfudu

v.t: These are of the reports of the towns—We relate them to you. Some are still standing, and some have withered away
v.l: Dhalika Min 'Anba'i Al-Qura Naqussuhu `Alayka Minha Qa'imun Wa Hasidun

v.t: We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. Their gods, whom they invoked besides God, availed them nothing when the command of your Lord arrived. In fact, they added only to their ruin
v.l: Wa Ma Zalamnahum Wa Lakin Zalamu 'Anfusahum Fama 'Aghnat `Anhum 'Alihatuhumu Allati Yad`una Min Duni Allahi Min Shay'in Lamma Ja'a 'Amru Rabbika Wa Ma Zaduhum Ghayra Tatbibin

v.t: Such is the grip of your Lord when He seizes the towns in the midst of their sins. His grip is most painful, most severe
v.l: Wa Kadhalika 'Akhdhu Rabbika 'Idha 'Akhadha Al-Qura Wa Hiya Zalimatun 'Inna 'Akhdhahu 'Alimun Shadidun

v.t: In that is a sign for whoever fears the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which humanity will be gathered together—that is a Day to be witnessed
v.l: Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Liman Khafa `Adhaba Al-'Akhirati Dhalika Yawmun Majmu`un Lahu An-Nasu Wa Dhalika Yawmun Mash/hudun

v.t: We only postpone it until a predetermined time
v.l: Wa Ma Nu'uakhkhiruhu 'Illa Li'jalin Ma`dudin

v.t: On the Day when it arrives, no soul will speak without His permission. Some will be miserable, and some will be happy
v.l: Yawma Ya'ti La Takallamu Nafsun 'Illa Bi'idhnihi Faminhum Shaqiyun Wa Sa`idun

v.t: As for those who are miserable, they will be in the Fire. They will have therein sighing and wailing
v.l: Fa'amma Al-Ladhina Shaqu Fafi An-Nari Lahum Fiha Zafirun Wa Shahiqun

v.t: Remaining therein for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills. Your Lord is Doer of whatever He wills
v.l: Khalidina Fiha Ma Damati As-Samawatu Wa Al-'Arđu 'Illa Ma Sha'a Rabbuka 'Inna Rabbaka Fa``alun Lima Yuridu

v.t: And as for those who are happy, they will be in Paradise, remaining therein for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills—a reward without end
v.l: Wa 'Amma Al-Ladhina Su`idu Fafi Al-Jannati Khalidina Fiha Ma Damati As-Samawatu Wa Al-'Arđu 'Illa Ma Sha'a Rabbuka `Ata'an Ghayra Majdhudhin

v.t: So be not in doubt regarding what these people worship. They worship only as their ancestors worshiped before. We will pay them their due in full, without any reduction
v.l: Fala Taku Fi Miryatin Mimma Ya`budu Ha'uula' Ma Ya`buduna 'Illa Kama Ya`budu 'Aba'uuhum Min Qablu Wa 'Inna Lamuwaffuhum Nasibahum Ghayra Manqusin
w: will surely pay them in full

v.t: We gave Moses the Scripture, but it was disputed. Were it not for a prior word from your Lord, it would have been settled between them. They are in serious doubt concerning it
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Musa Al-Kitaba Fakhtulifa Fihi Wa Lawla Kalimatun Sabaqat Min Rabbika Laquđiya Baynahum Wa 'Innahum Lafi Shakkin Minhu Muribin

v.t: Your Lord will repay each one of them in full for their deeds. He is Aware of everything they do
v.l: Wa 'Inna Kulla Lamma Layuwaffiyannahum Rabbuka 'A`malahum 'Innahu Bima Ya`maluna Khabirun
w: surely will pay them in full

v.t: So be upright, as you are commanded, along with those who repented with you, and do not transgress. He is Seeing of everything you do
v.l: Fastaqim Kama 'Umirta Wa Man Taba Ma`aka Wa La Tatghaw 'Innahu Bima Ta`maluna Basirun

v.t: And do not incline towards those who do wrong, or the Fire may touch you; and you will have no protectors besides God, and you will not be saved
v.l: Wa La Tarkanu 'Ila Al-Ladhina Zalamu Fatamassakumu An-Naru Wa Ma Lakum Min Duni Allahi Min 'Awliya'a Thumma La Tunsaruna

v.t: Perform the prayer at the borders of the day, and during the approaches of the night. The good deeds take away the bad deeds. This is a reminder for those who remember
v.l: Wa 'Aqimi As-Salaata Tarafayi An-Nahari Wa Zulafaan Mina Al-Layli 'Inna Al-Hasanati Yudh/hibna As-Sayyi'ati Dhalika Dhikra Lildhakirina

v.t: And be patient. God will not waste the reward of the virtuous
v.l: Wa Asbir Fa'inna Allaha La Yuđi`u 'Ajra Al-Muhsinina

v.t: If only there were, among the generations before you, people with wisdom, who spoke against corruption on earth—except for the few whom We saved. But the wrongdoers pursued the luxuries they were indulged in, and thus became guilty
v.l: Falawla Kana Mina Al-Quruni Min Qablikum 'Ulu Baqiyatin Yanhawna `Ani Al-Fasadi Fi Al-'Arđi 'Illa Qalilaan Mimman 'Anjayna Minhum Wa Attaba`a Al-Ladhina Zalamu Ma 'Utrifu Fihi Wa Kanu Mujrimina

v.t: Your Lord would never destroy the towns wrongfully, while their inhabitants are righteous
v.l: Wa Ma Kana Rabbuka Liyuhlika Al-Qura Bizulmin Wa 'Ahluha Muslihuna

v.t: Had your Lord willed, He could have made humanity one community, but they continue to differ
v.l: Wa Law Sha'a Rabbuka Laja`ala An-Nasa 'Ummatan Wahidatan Wa La Yazaluna Mukhtalifina

v.t: Except those on whom your Lord has mercy—for that reason He created them. The Word of your Lord is final: “I will fill Hell with jinn and humans, altogether.”
v.l: Illa Man Rahima Rabbuka Wa Lidhalika Khalaqahum Wa Tammat Kalimatu Rabbika La'amla'anna Jahannama Mina Al-Jinnati Wa An-Nasi 'Ajma`ina

v.t: Everything We narrate to you of the history of the messengers is to strengthen your heart therewith. The truth has come to you in this, and a lesson, and a reminder for the believers
v.l: Wa Kullaan Naqussu `Alayka Min 'Anba'i Ar-Rusuli Ma Nuthabbitu Bihi Fu'uadaka Wa Ja'aka Fi Hadhihi Al-Haqqu Wa Maw`izatun Wa Dhikra Lilmu'uminina

v.t: And say to those who do not believe, “Act according to your ability; and so will we.”
v.l: Wa Qul Lilladhina La Yu'uminuna A`malu `Ala Makanatikum 'Inna `Amiluna

v.t: “And wait; we too are waiting.”
v.l: Wa Antaziru 'Inna Muntaziruna

v.t: To God belongs the future of the heavens and the earth, and to Him all authority goes back. So worship Him, and rely on Him. Your Lord is never unaware of what you do
v.l: Wa Lillahi Ghaybu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa 'Ilayhi Yurja`u Al-'Amru Kulluhu Fa`bud/hu Wa Tawakkal `Alayhi Wa Ma Rabbuka Bighafilin `Amma Ta`maluna
